verdict_reason: All 14 keys were read side by side with the source. Enum IDs and setting identifiers appear nowhere in the values, so nothing machine-facing could drift; the three policy labels every sentence points at ('Reinicio más próximo', 'Más margen', 'Reparto equitativo') are byte-identical to the references inside legacy.help — proven mechanically by legacy_refs.py.txt, not by eye — and the true/false behavioural promise of the legacy switch survives verbatim. Every label fits the declared 29-cell budget (widest: legacy.label at 27). The single minor finding is the label dropping 'policy'; the nits are idiom and an unrecorded term decision. Nothing here ships a lie.

source_side_risks: The sidecar note on every key reads 'English-only child namespace; missing locale uses English fallback.' It is untrue at this revision — an es candidate exists and is being wired — so the note no longer describes the surface; it should be corrected upstream rather than read as an instruction.

Out of scope but measured: 'request' is rendered both 'petición' (7 es files) and 'solicitud' (9 es files), and 'computer' is 'máquina' everywhere except wire.errors.notifications.store_full ('Este equipo'), where 'equipo' also means 'team' in this locale. Neither is this namespace's doing; both need a locale-wide decision.

findings.detail: en 'account selection policy' (24 cells) -> es 'Selección de cuentas' (20): the word 'policy' is gone. The row is a policy selector, not an account list, and the es help then talks about 'políticas' ('Reinicio más próximo prefiere…', 'Una política explícita anula…') without the label ever having introduced a policy. The locale already settles this pattern: wire.settings.providers_openrouter_sort.label maps 'routing policy' -> 'política de enrutamiento'. Kept minor rather than major because the help text restores the meaning and no behaviour is misstated; the 29-cell maxCells is why the plain expansion 'Política de selección de cuentas' (32) cannot be used as-is.
findings.remediation: Within the declared 29-cell budget: 'Política de selección' (21) or 'Política de cuentas' (19). If the budget can rise, 'Política de selección de cuentas' (32) is the exact rendering.

findings.detail: 'A compatible, unexpired lease from a successful request' -> 'Una concesión compatible y sin vencer de una petición con éxito'. 'con éxito' is a calque of 'successful'; a Spanish UI writes 'una petición correcta' or 'una petición que ha ido bien'. Meaning is intact — this is idiom, not accuracy.
findings.remediation: 'Una concesión compatible y sin vencer de una petición correcta tiene prioridad en todas las políticas; …'.

findings.detail: 'lease' -> 'concesión' is a new domain term with no glossary row and no other occurrence in the catalogue (grep 'lease' matches only this key). 'concesión' is defensible (a bounded grant); the risk is that the next wave picks a different word ( 'préstamo', 'cesión', or English 'lease').
findings.remediation: Record the call in i18n/style-guides/es.md (locale calls) or the glossary so wave 2+ inherits it.
